scope: Source/convention/tolerance guidance for actual future selected R36 workers. Does not append frontier, reserve budget, grant review or qualify a product.

contract.factor: For each positive radial/angular quadrature node, b_i(k,u)=g_i*(n_i.u)*exp(i*k*u.x_i)*sqrt(P0(k)*w_k*w_Omega/(2*pi)^3)*S_R(k). Split real/imaginary columns. The k^-1 velocity factor cancels k² radial measure. P0 in Mpc³, k in Mpc^-1, b in km/s. H03 V=B directly; not R30 modulus derivative j_i*B. Stream A V and accumulate its real Gram matrix; preserve all36 coordinates and cross-window/cross-smoothing blocks.
ownership_resolution: Retained sigma²=250²+(70 ln10/5*d*e_dmzp)² is an inherited weighting/conditional law, not an empirical independent-noise decomposition. Reproduce it as C_baseline only.
Do not automatically form C_baseline+C_PV or subtract250² and call the remainder source measurement noise. That would assert unproved source ownership.

Deliver C_PV for the declared bands plus the general map C(D,Sigma)=A diag(D) A^T+C_PV+K Sigma K^T. A fully numerical total is permitted under an explicit CONDITIONAL law that independently stipulates D and calibration Sigma, excludes represented PV/calibration terms and records omitted bands/cross sources. It is not an empirical estimate. Unsupplied empirical amplitudes/cross blocks remain symbolic/UNKNOWN, never zero-filled.

The saved four-method Z=d*onehot maps mean-design offsets in km/s/Mpc. K=A Z is a legitimate design response with that parameter convention; it is not automatically a mag zero-point Jacobian. Physical modulus shifts change d, X and possibly W; derive their full chosen estimator derivative before using mag² Sigma.
If calibration/PV sources correlate, factor their joint law including cross blocks; disjoint labels alone do not establish independence.

Do not restart its old K_fact runner, bank, 600-second account or exhausted refinements. New source-mode contractions belong only to the actual R36 packet and its host-specified hard cap. Preparation grants no execution budget.
controls: Run the supplied eight covariance tests unchanged.

Use <=12-row independent pair kernel J_ij=(j0+j2)*(n_i.n_j)/3-j2*(n_i.s_hat)*(n_j.s_hat), coincident limit(n_i.n_j)/3, to check2pi, phase, positive sign and radial units; compare Frobenius relative1e-5 and normalized entries1e-6, inherited R30 fixture criteria.

Freeze positive quadrature nodes and a nested refinement before output; reuse existing angular/radial conventions if practical. Report max normalized entry change<=.005, Frobenius<=.003 and inverse-whitened spectral change<=.02 on support, inherited R30 numerical tolerances, applied separately to every H03 block; failing checks HOLD that numerical approximation, not all conditional mathematics.

Unit-column whitened SVD at primary1e-10 with1e-12/1e-8 sensitivity; identical source/observer columns keep relative-only rank. Cross-source covariance, permutation and common-field cross-window controls.
Footprint/method sensitivity must use separately declared operators; prior saved scalar sensitivities alone do not supply their new PV covariance. No repeated old model fit.
contract.statistics: Known analytic Gaussian law allows an exact conditional GLS reference for a fixed linear mean with known covariance and prespecified rank. Finite-mock covariance requires sample-covariance uncertainty; N64,p36 inverse factor26/63 alone is inadequate. Refit only explicitly distinct new H03 mean designs, same extraction and fixed selection rule; do not invent total mean from zero-mean PV component or claim identical CF4 samples independent.
contract.conditional_completion: A source-bound operator transport plus computed PSD band component and explicit parameterized calibration/decomposition sensitivity is a legitimate scientific conditional product. Full frozen acceptance still requires its named output and independent review; an input-gap report alone does not qualify.
